I bought a Red Sox cap for Jack and a mug for Sam.
Ha! Jack is going to love it. And I took two hundred photos!
I know! You took a photo of every church!
Well, I saw the Freedom Trail, and I had my camera… What did you prefer?
Harvard! We met that nice student, and he gave us a tour.
Yes! And the clam chowder at Quincy Market… I ate two bowls!
Wait… where's my ticket, Emma? I didn't put it in my bag!
Relax! It's on your phone. You got an e-ticket!

Six months ago, I didn't know anybody here. Now I have wonderful friends.
And your English is great now!
Thanks! In September, I was so nervous. Now I speak English every day.
I'm proud of you! So, what are you going to do next?
I'm going to take an English class. And next summer, I'm going to drive on Route 66 with Jack and Sam!
